_meta.apparel_super_id_resolution: RESOLVED 2026-06-18 from backend/app/data/meesho_category_tree.json (the seed source for the categories.super_id column): apparel/footwear/kids-clothing supers are 10 (Men Fashion), 11 (Women Fashion), 29 (Women), 13 (Kids & Toys), 25 (Kids). Footwear has no distinct super — its leaves (Casual Shoes, Flip Flops, Sandals, Bellies, Boots) live inside supers 10/11/13, so size/fabric rules attach to those supers. NOT guessed — extracted directly from the seeded tree.
